changelog:
Initial release of backend-admin-dev-skill.

- Introduces Project Portal, a project management backend system based on Vue 3 + Flask.
- Implements RBAC permissions, multi-project management, user/role/menu management.
- Integrates image upload management, rich text editing, and S3-compatible storage (with independent Flask S3 server).
- Provides dynamic content (news) and category management, system settings, and logs.
- Offers Docker deployment examples and API grouping; security and naming best practices documented.
summary: Develop and manage backend admin features including RBAC, multi-projects, image upload with S3 integration, dynamic content, system settings, and secure toke...
